input_file.description: Read input from this file. Default: stdin

output_file.description: Write output to this file. If a directory, bar creates a file with the input file's name inside it. Default: stdout

size.description: Expect an input stream of this many bytes. Supports suffixes k, m, g, t, p, e, b (if block-size is set first).

completed.description: Instruct bar that this many bytes have already been copied (continuation of previous transfer).

buffer_size.description: Allocate an I/O buffer of this many bytes. Default: 52488 (512 KiB). Same modifiers as size allowed.

throttle.description: Restrict I/O throughput to this rate in bytes per second. Same modifiers as size allowed.

interval.description: Update the display every this many seconds. Default: 1

display_wait.description: Wait for the first byte of data before displaying anything.

kilobyte.description: Use either 1000 or 1024 as the definition of a kilobyte for size/scale parsing.

block_size.description: When parsing sizes in blocks (suffix b), assume a single block is this many bytes. Must be set before any block-based sizes.

screen_width.description: Assume a fixed screen width of this many characters; overrides terminal detection. Use 0 to disable override.

screen_width_minus_one.description: Use full terminal width minus one for screen width.

screen_height.description: Assume a fixed screen height of this many characters; useful only with info-file.

screen_height_minus_one.description: Use full terminal height minus one for screen height.

title.description: Set the title string. No title shown unless explicitly set.

display_twiddle.description: Turn on/off the twirling twiddle character in the display.

display_title.description: Turn on/off the title in the display.

display_count.description: Turn on/off the data count in the display.

display_count_bits.description: Display the data count in bits instead of bytes.

display_throughput.description: Turn on/off the data throughput in the display.

display_throughput_bits.description: Display throughput in bits/second instead of bytes/second.

display_time.description: Turn on/off the time (elapsed or ETA) in the display.

display_elapsed_only.description: Force bar to display elapsed time instead of ETA.

display_percent.description: Turn on/off percent complete in the display.

display_bar.description: Turn on/off the progress bar in the display.

display_summary.description: Turn on/off the summary information displayed at completion.

display_numeric.description: Display percent as integer per line instead of full display. Requires known total size.

display_ansi.description: Turn on/off the use of ANSI color codes in the display.

info_file.description: Path to info file. Sections separated by '@@@' are shown as transfer progresses.

twiddle_fg.description: Twiddle foreground color. Valid: normal, black, red, green, yellow, blue, magenta, cyan, white

twiddle_bg.description: Twiddle background color. Valid: same as above

twiddle_bold.description: Use bold font for the twiddle.

title_bold.description: Use bold font for the title.

count_bold.description: Use bold font for the data count.

throughput_label_bold.description: Use bold font for the throughput label.

throughput_bold.description: Use bold font for the throughput value.

time_label_bold.description: Use bold font for the time label.

time_bold.description: Use bold font for the time value.

percent_bold.description: Use bold font for the percent.

bar_brace_fg.description: Bar brace (brackets around bar) foreground color.

bar_brace_bold.description: Use bold font for the bar braces.

bar_bold.description: Use bold font for the bar.

bar_openbrace_char.description: Open brace character for the progress bar.

bar_closebrace_char.description: Close brace character for the progress bar.

bar_complete_char.description: Character used for the completed portion of the bar.

bar_incomplete_char.description: Character used for the incomplete portion of the bar.

space_bg.description: Background color used for spacing between display objects.
